purpose: Show the product and then its real detail while preserving access to the main action.

timing.mapping: linear input; explicit interpolation between keys

interruption: re-evaluate from current progress; no queued navigation side effects
reverse: same deterministic mapping in both directions
cleanup: remove owned observers, listeners, animation callbacks and resources
mobile: separate framing; ordinary document flow where pinning is unsuitable
fallback: poster with semantic content and working action
